title: Regional safety valve: traffic constriction and short-circuit sanity guard
author: Maya Thompson
description: This PR introduces a regional "safety valve" that can constrict incoming traffic at the serving edge when regional health probes or anomaly detectors spike error/latency signals. Motivation: previous incidents showed tail latency and KV-cache thrash in isolated regions could cascade into global degradation. The valve provides a short-circuit path for new long-running requests, a configurable tokenized admission window, and a diagnostic endpoint for on-call to observe decisions. The change includes: 1) a lightweight runtime guard that enforces per-region inflight caps and a soft reject path that returns a structured 503 with a diagnostic header; 2) a 'constriction' policy engine that smooths admission changes using exponential cooldown + jitter to avoid oscillation; 3) telemetry enhancements: new metrics and labels for constriction_reason, applied_threshold, and inflight_snapshot; 4) an opt-in control-plane API and Helm config to enable automatic or manual valve modes; 5) integration tests and a runbook. Checklist: [x] implement runtime valve and short-circuit response [x] add policy smoothing and cooldown logic [x] emit telemetry and traces for decision path [x] expose admin API + Helm flag [x] integration tests + runbook [x] manual canary in staging and roll to production
commits: 4 commits: 1) valve: add admission controller and short-circuit response (valve.go, response.go); 2) policy: constriction smoothing and cooldown algorithm; 3) telemetry: metrics, tracing hooks, dashboard templates; 4) tests/docs: integration tests and runbook updates

release_notes: Introduces a regional safety valve that constricts incoming traffic under regional anomaly conditions. Provides opt-in automatic and manual modes, emits detailed telemetry for debugging, includes Helm flags and an admin API. Useful for isolating noisy regions and preventing cascade failures.
notes_for_release: Default is disabled; enable via helm value 'safetyValve.enabled=true' for automatic activation or use the admin API for manual control. Observe metrics 'safety_valve.active' and 'safety_valve.dropped_requests_ratio' before enabling in production.

backout_plan: Rollback helm flag and re-deploy previous release, or toggle admin API to manual-off. If short-circuits cause unacceptable customer impact, disable then run warmup to re-introduce traffic slowly.
notes_on_tests: Integration test simulates inflight saturation and asserts short-circuit header and metric emission. e2e in staging validated cooldown hysteresis against a synthetic spike pattern.
additional_context: Related work: complements tenant-weighted soft fallback strategies, designed to be a last-mile protection to keep meshes and KV caches stable. Not a replacement for upstream autoscaling but reduces blast radius during control plane or regional infra anomalies.
